are_you_ok.title: 'Those are two very tragic events' | Two people die in separate possible storm-related drownings in San Antonio
questions: I saw San Antonio had some serious flooding - are you and your family all right?
Is flooding in the drainage areas something that affects the roads you normally drive?
are_you_ok.description: “On Friday evening, two individuals were in a drainage area when they were swept away by rapidly moving water during the heavy rainfall."
